concerns.text: The specification (SC-002) requires measurement of the final subspace alignment (cosine similarity of the final update direction). The task list includes early‑trajectory alignment (T040‑early‑alignment‑core, T040b‑baseline‑alignment) but provides no task that computes or logs the final alignment score for any variant, violating the acceptance criterion.

FR-007 mandates mixed‑precision (FP16) training, yet no task in the list verifies that FP16 is enabled for any training variant (e.g., a task to check torch dtype or to assert FP16 usage). Absence of such verification weakens the functional requirement.
